summary: Service-operator role derivation failure causing ephemeral sandbox access denials
description: Issue summary: Several engineers reported immediate ASSUME_ROLE failures when accessing ephemeral 'experimental' sandboxes in staging after the nightly IAM provisioning run (2026-03-10 02:15 UTC). Impact: Multiple dev and e2e CI jobs blocked; cannot attach operator roles to sandbox sessions for debugging. Affects staging sandboxes and any env that relies on the 'service-operator' template derivation path. Observed: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and sts:AssumeRole errors referencing org-policy tag checks and 'Missing required session tag: environment' denies. Expected: service-operator templates should produce session tags matching org-policy expectations and allow sandbox principals to assume the role.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create ephemeral sandbox via dev-self-serve with template 'redwood-experimental'
2) Attempt to assume role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-operator-staging with sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
3) Observe 403 / AccessDenied with message referencing missing session tag or tag mismatch
4) Check provisioning logs for derivation output for that sandbox's role binding
logs: 2026-03-10T02:17:03Z ERROR iam-provisioner: role-derivation failed for sandbox/redwood-exp-42: missing 'env' tag in derived-session -> org-policy: TagRequirement(enforced)
AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity denied: 'Missing required session tag: environment' (request-id: a1b2c3d4)
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-staging-experimental: binding includes member 'serviceAccount:redwood-experimental' but expected 'group:redwood-experimental@redwood.com'
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: recent change in infra-provisioner (PR #1728) introduced a normalization step that strips short prefixes from principal tags. The role derivation engine uses those tags to populate sessionTags for sts assume; org-policy enforces 'environment' session tag presence which now doesn't match. Replayed the provisioning job locally and confirmed derived role documents omit 'environment=staging' tag for certain sandbox names that start with 'redwood-'. Also observed a simultaneous mis-formatting of a GCP binding (serviceAccount vs group) from the template renderer. The combination led to immediate denies both on AWS (sts) and GCP (role binding mismatch).
comments: Marta Alvarez (reporter) - 2026-03-10: Noticed CI flip on several PRs that use ephemeral sandboxes. Pasted STS deny above and flagged infra team.

Ethan Cole (assignee) - 2026-03-10: Investigating provisioning run artifacts and recent infra-provisioner PRs. Suspicious change in tag-normalizer module. Assigned to iam-provisioner owner for rollback gate.

SRE-Team (2026-03-11): Confirmed org-policy enforces session tag 'environment' for assume-role; when missing the policy denies before role sessions created. Added temporary bypass on a single sandbox to unblock one oncall session.
Infra Provisioner Owner - 2026-03-11: PR #1728 added 'shortTag' normalization to improve UX; did not run full policy matrix test. Reverting change for staging pending fix.
Security - 2026-03-12: Advised against broad org-policy relaxations; prefer fixing derivation pipeline.
resolution: Partial remediation performed 2026-03-12: rolled back PR #1728 in staging, re-ran provisioning reconciliation to re-derive session tags, and manually patched 8 affected sandbox role bindings. CI and developer access restored for impacted sandboxes. Root cause: tag-normalizer trimmed 'env' token when template contained hyphenated sandbox names; edge-case not covered by unit tests. GCP binding mis-formatting was caused by an unescaped template variable in the same commit. Full fix scheduled and will include: robust session-tag unit tests, add e2e gating against org-policy matrix, stricter template lint rules, and a reconciliation job to detect drift.
next_steps: 1) Merge hotfix to infra-provisioner that preserves 'environment' tag tokens for all template names (owner: @infra-owner) - target 2026-03-14
2) Add org-policy simulation tests to infra-provisioner CI matrix - target 2026-03-16
3) Backfill reconciliation job to scan all staging and dedicated sandboxes for session tag presence; auto-notify owners when mismatch - target 2026-03-18
4) Postmortem draft and confluence runbook updates for role derivation and test coverage - owner: Ethan Cole - due 2026-03-20
5) Follow-up internal ticket to run cross-account smoke tests for private deployments after change lands - create INT follow-up to track
